title: Infield fly, nobody touches it: batter out, putout to the closest infielder

expect.line: b1 out on an infield fly to SS.
expect.note: The batter is out by the call, not by a catch, so the out carries no putoutTouchId: nobody touched the ball. The putout goes to the fielder who would have caught it (Mark, 2026-10-23: the closest infielder), derived from the landing against the profile's standard spots. Until alignment is recorded (M2) that is the standard spot, so a shifted infield can credit the wrong fielder. No force anywhere, so both runners hold without a question being asked.
